appStore.name: Lissom
appStore.subtitle: Camera-based mobility tests
appStore.promotionalText: Twelve camera-based mobility tests you run at home. Lissom measures what it can see and says what it can't — no coaching, no plan, just your own numbers over time.

playStore.shortDescription: Twelve camera mobility tests, measured on-device. Nothing is uploaded.

description:
Lissom is a wellness app for measuring how you move, using your phone's camera — twelve tests, done at home with no equipment.

Put your phone where it can see your full body, and Lissom reads the test from the camera as you do it. Every result is shown as the number it measured — a distance, a duration, or a degree — dated, and kept as your own raw history. When a test shows a band, the band reflects your own past sessions, not a clinical threshold.

MEASURED
Twelve movement tests: Overhead Reach, Deep Squat, Overhead Squat, Ankle Mobility, Standing Forward Reach, Hip Hinge, Side Bend, Single-Leg Balance, Forward Lunge, Seated Torso Rotation, Active Straight Leg Raise, and Plank Hold. Each test's own value, with the date, kept on this device.

WHAT LISSOM DOES NOT DO
- It does not build you a daily plan or tell you what to change — there is no coaching layer today, only measurement.
- It does not draw a trend line or say a result is better or worse than a past one — no validated threshold exists for that comparison.
- It does not remind or schedule you — how long two measurements need to be apart to mean anything is something we haven't established.
- It does not show a camera preview while you're being measured — the measurement runs either way, but the picture itself isn't shown on that screen.

Everything runs on your device. The camera image is read live and never leaves your phone — no video is saved, and nothing is uploaded anywhere.

Lissom is a general wellness app. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose or treat any condition, and is not a substitute for professional medical or physical therapy advice.

Measured, not guessed.
